evaluations.prompt: Write a C99 function to reverse an array of 32-bit integers in place.
evaluations.output:
<think>
We use two indices `i = 0` and `j = n - 1` and swap `arr[i]` and `arr[j]` until `i >= j`.
</think>
```c
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>

void reverse_i32(int32_t *arr, size_t n) {
    if (!arr || n < 2) return;
    size_t i = 0, j = n - 1;
    while (i < j) {
        int32_t tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
        ++i;
        --j;
    }
}
```
